T: Put on a show. Put on the kettle.
D: Walter, Gary and Mary get the Muppets back together to save their old theatre from an oil baron.
P: Serve the snacks when the telethon finally goes live.
S: the big telethon to save the Muppet Theater

A cob loaf cut deep in a crisscross, stuffed with cheddar, mozzarella and garlic chive butter, baked until bubbling for everyone manning the phones. Cut a cob loaf in a crisscross pattern about 3cm apart, going deep but not through the base. Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped chives. Push 150g grated cheddar and 150g grated mozzarella into the cuts and spoon the garlic butter over. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes, then open the foil and bake 10 minutes more until the cheese bubbles. Put it in the middle of the table and pull apart.
Pork and beef meatballs browned and simmered in cream with allspice
Pork and beef meatballs with onion and allspice, browned and simmered in a creamy gravy, served with lingonberry jam on toothpicks.
Thick fries fried twice, salted, served in paper cones
Thick fries cooked twice until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.
M: Mary's anniversary dinner in Los Angeles

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice pilaf. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket into the side of 4 chicken breasts and stuff with the mixture, closing with toothpicks. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1 cup basmati with a little butter and 2 cups stock, covered, for 15 minutes. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and parsley for the sauce and spoon over the sliced chicken.
Seared sirloin, thin fries and tarragon bearnaise sauce
Steak frites of sirloin seared and rested, with thin fries and a béarnaise of yolks, butter and tarragon. Not pork.
W: Biscuit base topped with green peppermint icing
Biscuit base topped with a pale green peppermint icing and a dark chocolate top, chilled and cut into squares.
K: Cranberry, pineapple and orange juice layered and topped with lemonade
Orange, pineapple and cranberry juice layered over ice and topped with lemonade.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll the meatballs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; brown them and simmer in the cream just before serving

steps.text: Mix the mince with the onion and allspice, then roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs in the olive oil.
Add the cream and a splash of water and simmer.
Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam.

veg.make_ahead: Mix and roll the balls up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; brown and simmer in the cream on the night

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the onion and allspice, then roll into small balls.
Brown the balls in the oil.
Add the cream, a splash of water and the soy sauce and simmer.
Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in cold water; drain, dry and fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 140C until soft.
Rest the fries.
Fry again in the oil at 190C until crisp.
Toss with sea salt and pile into paper cones with tomato sauce on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes and do the first fry up to 3 hours ahead; sear the steaks and make the bearnaise just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry twice in the vegetable oil until crisp.
Season the steaks with salt and pepper and sear.
Rest the steaks.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon.
Whisk in the egg yolks over gentle heat.
Slowly add the melted butter, whisking.
Serve the steak over the fries.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 3 hours ahead and keep them in cold water; fry, sear the mushrooms and make the bearnaise on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry twice in the vegetable oil until crisp.
Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil until browned and tender, season with salt and pepper and keep warm.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon.
Whisk in the egg yolks over gentle heat.
Slowly add the melted butter, whisking.
Serve the mushrooms over the fries with the bearnaise.

ingredients.item: green food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Crush the biscuits and mix with the melted butter.
Press into a lined tin.
Chill the base.
Beat the icing sugar with the softened butter, peppermint essence and green colouring.
Spread over the base.
Melt the chocolate and pour on top.
Chill until set.
Cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the juices and lemonade up to 1 day ahead; layer the glasses just before serving so the colours stay separate

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice.
Pour in the cranberry juice first.
Slowly add the pineapple juice and then the orange juice over the back of a spoon so they layer.
Top with lemonade.

s.note: Pork and beef meatballs browned and simmered in cream with allspice
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince and 250g beef mince with a grated onion and a pinch of allspice. Roll into small balls and brown. Add 200ml cream and a splash of water and simmer 10 minutes. Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam. Bork bork.

s.note: Thick fries fried twice, salted, served in paper cones
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry. Fry at 140C until soft, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Toss with sea salt and pile into paper cones with tomato sauce on the side. Smalltown, USA approved.

m.note: Seared sirloin, thin fries and tarragon bearnaise sauce
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Reduce white wine vinegar with tarragon, whisk in 2 yolks over gentle heat, then slowly add 150g melted butter. Serve the steak over the fries. Not pork.

w.note: Biscuit base topped with green peppermint icing
w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 300g icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint essence and green colouring and spread over. Pour melted dark chocolate on top, chill and cut into squares.

d.note: Cranberry, pineapple and orange juice layered and topped with lemonade
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice. Pour in cranberry juice first, then slowly add pineapple juice and orange juice over the back of a spoon so they layer. Top with lemonade. A rainbow in a glass for the show.
